externalParents.title: Green–Tao: The quantitative behaviour of polynomial orbits on nilmanifolds
externalParents.translation: Theorem2.9: polynomial sequence in a filtered nilmanifold with delta^-1-rational Malcev basis; failure of delta-equidistribution gives bounded nonzero horizontal character with bounded C-infinity norm. Theorem1.19: factorization at fixed degree/dimension/rationality into smooth, equidistributed and rational parts. FT must additionally verify all rescaled sequence, metric and progression hypotheses.

externalParents.title: Green–Tao: The Möbius function is strongly orthogonal to nilsequences
externalParents.translation: Published arithmetic weight is integer Mobius; FT substitutes its ideal-norm estimates and ideal Type I/II alternative. This adaptation is not certified by citing the published proposition.

externalParents.title: Matthiesen: Linear correlations amongst numbers represented by positive definite binary quadratic forms
externalParents.translation: Polynomial-subsequence equidistribution is the model for FT4.4. FT uses a changed coefficient/scale range that requires its own proof.

externalParents.title: Bienvenu: A higher-dimensional Siegel–Walfisz theorem
externalParents.translation: Admissible affine system, polylogarithmic size, positive images, convex volume at least N^d/log^A(N). For ordinary-prime cube subfamilies with W polylogarithmic, apply the relative asymptotic and cancel by inclusion–exclusion. Non-admissible finite initial cases are excluded by sufficiently large W.

externalParents.title: Dodos–Kanellopoulos: Uniformity norms, their weaker versions, and applications
externalParents.translation: Use s=u+1≥2, C≥20, prime Nprime in[CN,2CN], real f dominated by nonnegative nu, target norm at least delta, majorant U^(2s) norm within eta. Increase FT majorant parameter to D=4^(u+1). Final typeset statement not compared.

externalParents.title: Green–Tao: Linear equations in primes
externalParents.translation: Ordinary-prime majorant, generalized von Neumann estimate and normal-form reduction. Fixed conductor multiplier in W requires the recorded adaptation. Original GI/MN assumptions are discharged by later published theorems.

externalParents.theorem: Main inverse theorem, used through DK Theorem5.1
externalParents.title: Green–Tao–Ziegler: An inverse theorem for the Gowers U^(s+1)[N]-norm
externalParents.translation: Bounded-function inverse theorem underlying the published relative inverse theorem. It is not a replacement for the majorant norm hypothesis.

externalParents.title: Kane: An asymptotic for the number of solutions to linear equations in prime numbers from specified Chebotarev classes
externalParents.translation: Passage to cyclic characters and Hecke Siegel–Walfisz. Theorem2 handles one linear relation and does not directly replace arbitrary cube correlations.

externalParents.title: Green–Tao: Quadratic uniformity of the Möbius function
externalParents.translation: Divisor moments, removing variable interval constraints and Cauchy–Schwarz steps in the ideal Type I/II argument. Exact source statement not checked in this subaudit.
